notes.title: Patch v.1.01 Virgin Ending fix
notes.content:
Hey Folks,

the virgin ending in v.1.0 is unreachable due to a bug. v.1.01 attempts to fix it.

Patchnotes:

[list]
[*] Act Skip and Gallery Menu should stay on screen in different resolutions.
[*] Futa Phantom struggle glitch fixed.
[*] Virgin Ending should now be reachable.
[*] Some dialogue refinements.
[/list]

That's it for now

Greets! :>

tags.bug: [*] Virgin Ending should now be reachable.
